verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. `profileConeGap = 2 - (v-2)·tilt²` is this formula verbatim in the case t_s = 0, where A_n = n_θ, B_n = n_z and B_n/A_n = tilt = T₀z/T₀θ. The general-t_s form is `directionGap`, with denominators cleared: substituting A_n = (1+st)/√(1+t²), B_n = (t-s)/√(1+t²) gives (1+t²)·A_n²·G_n = 2(1+st)² - (v-2)(t-s)² = directionGap v s t, an exact identity. Both cleared factors are positive wherever A_n ≠ 0, so G_n > 0 ⇔ directionGap > 0 and lower bounds transfer up to those positive factors. Lean's `v` is the speed v_s and its `s` the shear tilt t_s.
